name: Utahceratops
sum: Utahceratops is a large chasmosaurine with a wide, short-horned frill from the Kaiparowits Formation of Utah.
wsnote: Estimates in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: UMNH VP 16784, a partial skull — Kaiparowits Formation, Grand Staircase–Escalante National Monument, Utah.
material: Further specimens from the same monument.
author: Sampson et al. 2010
